data.one_liner: Annotations and helper lenses for generating boilerplate for immutable data types.
data.what_it_does: Generates mixins providing operator==, hashCode, copyWith, toString, and lenses for data classes via build_runner. Lenses allow viewing and modifying nested data structures immutably.
use_when: You want immutable data classes with equality, copying, and string representations without writing boilerplate.
You need to deeply update nested data structures using lenses.
avoid_when: You prefer writing data classes and copy methods by hand.
You want an alternative code generator like Freezed that handles unions and pattern matching.
strengths: Minimally intrusive on class design by using mixins.
Powerful lens support for manipulating nested objects and collections.
weaknesses: Requires running build_runner for code generation.
Limited feature set compared to broader generators like Freezed.
data.setup_notes: Add build_runner and functional_data_generator to dev_dependencies and run build_runner.
